release_notes.zh-CN:
AskAll 齐问 1.0.4：支持附件上传，聊天卡片布局与 AI 顺序可配置。

新增：
- 提问支持上传附件（图片 / PDF / 文档）：单个 ≤5MB、单次 ≤10MB、最多 5 个，自动随问题注入所选 AI 站点
- 新增默认 AI 平台「元宝」
- 聊天卡片布局可配置：田字格（多列，奇数数量最后一张占满整行）或单列，设置中切换、实时生效
- 设置中可调整 AI 平台顺序（上/下箭头），聊天卡片按新顺序展示
- 回答卡片新增「同步」按钮：进行中（发送中/回复中）时点击，手动刷新该 AI 的最新回答状态
- 悬浮面板标题栏与操作按钮增加悬停提示

优化：
- 回答卡片等高排列、内容区自适应，「展开全文 / 内容已截断」提示固定在卡片底部
- 流式回答滚动更平滑，消除更新时的抖动
- 附件上传采用「接力 + 乐观兜底」策略，提升上传成功率
- AI 选择下拉优化：切换勾选不关闭面板，已选 AI 图标全部展示
- 历史记录存储优化：解除容量上限，采用分级保留（近期保留完整内容，更早仅保留话题与链接）

修复：
- 修复附上附件后不发送、整单中止的问题
- 修复 AI 下拉中点击行取消选中被打断的问题

发布说明：
- 移除 Tauri 桌面端代码（apps/desktop），仅保留浏览器扩展主线，专注插件维护
release_notes.en:
AskAll 1.0.4: attachment uploads, configurable chat card layout and AI order.

New:
- Attach files to your question (images / PDF / docs): up to 5MB each, 10MB total, max 5 files, auto-injected into the selected AI sites along with the question
- New default AI platform: 元宝 (Yuanbao)
- Configurable chat card layout: grid (multi-column, last card spans the full row on odd counts) or single column; switch in settings, takes effect live
- Reorder AI platforms in settings (up/down arrows); chat cards follow the new order
- New "Sync" button on answer cards: while in progress (sending/replying), click to manually refresh that AI's latest answer state
- Hover tooltips for the floating panel title bar and action buttons

Improvements:
- Answer cards align to equal height with an adaptive content area; "expand full text / truncated" hints stay fixed at the bottom
- Smoother streaming scroll, eliminating jitter during updates
- Attachment upload now uses a relay + optimistic fallback strategy for a higher success rate
- AI picker improvements: toggling a selection keeps the dropdown open; all selected AI icons are shown
- History storage optimized: size cap removed, tiered retention keeps full content for recent entries and topic + link only for older ones

Fixes:
- Fixed uploads that never sent or aborted the whole round
- Fixed toggling a row in the AI picker being interrupted

Release notes:
- Removed the Tauri desktop app (apps/desktop); the project now maintains the browser extension only
